subtitle: Datasets, matrix layout, parameters, and drillthrough — all built for real

code:
SELECT t.SalesTerritoryRegion, d.CalendarYear,
       SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount
FROM FactInternetSales AS f
JOIN DimSalesTerritory AS t ON f.SalesTerritoryKey = t.SalesTerritoryKey
JOIN DimDate AS d ON f.OrderDateKey = d.DateKey
WHERE t.SalesTerritoryGroup = @TerritoryGroup
  AND d.CalendarYear IN (@CalendarYear)
GROUP BY t.SalesTerritoryRegion, d.CalendarYear;
caption: Parameters filter inside the query itself, not after the rows arrive.
